g.text: Interpreting a coefficient while holding others fixed
In the equation above, Ŷ is the predicted criterion variable value for the
X₁, X₂, X₃, X₄ and X₅ predictor variable values.
The symbols b₁, b₂, b₃, b₄ and b₅ are the regression coefficients for each
predictor, whereas a is the regression constant.
In multiple regression analysis, for each unit of change in the predictor
variable value, the Ŷ value of the criterion variable will change by b unit
when the other fixed predictor variables do not change.
By using teaching effectiveness as the criterion variable and the five
teaching techniques as the predictor variables, the multiple regression
test can determine and describe the extent the five teaching techniques
contribute to the teaching effectiveness of this group of tutors.
